facts.statement: Shartegosuchus is a genus of crocodyliform belonging to the protosuchian grade.
facts.quote: Shartegosuchus is a genus of protosuchian-grade crocodyliform.

facts.statement: The genus is known mainly from specimen PIN 4174/2, which consists of a partially deformed skull and jaws of a juvenile.
facts.quote: It is known primarily from PIN 4174/2, the partial deformed skull and jaws of a juvenile.

facts.statement: The fossil was found in ancient lake deposits of the Upper Jurassic Ulan Malgait Formation in southwestern Mongolia.
facts.quote: This specimen was discovered in ancient lake deposits of the Tithonian-age Upper Jurassic Ulan Malgait Formation, southwestern Mongolia.

facts.statement: Mikhail Efimov described the genus in 1988, with S. asperopalatum designated as the type species.
facts.quote: Shartegosuchus was described in 1988 by Mikhail Efimov, and the type species is S. asperopalatum.

facts.statement: Shartegosuchus is assigned to the family Shartegosuchidae, a group that also includes the similar genus Nominosuchus.
facts.quote: This genus was similar to Nominosuchus, and both are assigned to the same family (Shartegosuchidae).

facts.statement: Shartegosuchus lived during the Tithonian age of the Upper Jurassic in southwestern Mongolia.
facts.quote: This specimen was discovered in ancient lake deposits of the Tithonian-age Upper Jurassic Ulan Malgait Formation, southwestern Mongolia.

facts.statement: The animal lived between 149.2 and 143.1 million years ago during the Tithonian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Tithonian to Tithonian (149.2 to 143.1 million years ago)

facts.statement: Shartegosuchus is classified within the superorder Crocodylomorpha.
The animal belongs to the suborder Protosuchia.
Shartegosuchus is the type genus of the family Shartegosuchidae.
Shartegosuchus is classified within the class Sauropsida.
